name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 28 times in 8 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 56 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-01-16, at wavelengths from 0.78 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
